program.name: Calm Bodyweight
program.subject: Calm strength
program.blurb: No equipment, no hurry: core work, slow bodyweight strength and a long yin finish.
program.about: Strength with no equipment and no hurry. Each session opens with a core circuit, then slow bodyweight strength, push-ups, squats and floor pulls, then finishes with long, quiet yin holds. From day 21 every rep gets a slow lowering, and Level III adds reps on top. Nothing jumps, and there is no separate abs finisher.
program.split: Core, slow strength & yin A / B
